chapter.verse: Paul pen Derbe leh Lystra ah zong tung hi. Tua takah thu-um Jew numei khat ii tapa Timothy minnei nungzui khat om a, a pa ahihleh Greek mi ahi hi.
Lystra leh Iconium khua sanggamte in amah phat uh hi.
Paul in Timothy amah tawh kithuah ding deih a, tua mun lam tenga om Jew mite' huhau-in amah samin vun-at sangsak hi. A hang pen a pa Greek ahihlam tua mite in thei tek uh hi.
Tua ciangin khuapi citeng ah zin uh a, Jerusalem khua-a om sawltakte leh makaite' khensatsa thubullette a zuih nadingun amaute' tungah gensawn uh hi.
Tua hangin pawlpite zong upna thu ah thakhauh uh a, nisimin mi phazah khang uh hi.
Tua ciangin Asia gam ah thu gen lo dingin Kha Siangtho in kham ahih manin amau zong Phrygia leh Galatia gam sung teng ah pai uh hi.
Mysia gam a tun uh ciangin Bithynia gam sung lut sawm uh himah taleh Jesu' Kha in amaute phal lo hi.
Tua hangin Mysia gamnawl nawkin Troas khua ah paisuk uh hi.
Zan ciangin Paul' tungah muhtuam khat kilang a, Macedonia gam mi khat ding kawmin ama' kiangah, “Macedonia gam hong pai inla kote hong huh in,” ci-in kho hi.
Paul' muhtuam a man ciangin Pasian in tua mite' kiangah Lungdamna Thu a va tangko dingin ei hong seh ci-in khiatna tun ka hih manun Macedonia gam pai ka sawm pah uh hi.
Tua hangin Troas khua pan tembaw tawh tangtak pai-in Samothrace tuikulh, a zingciangin Neapolis khua,
tua panin Macedonia gam sung khuapi lian leh Rome colony khat ahi Philippi khua ka tung uh hi. Hih khua ah tawlkhat sung ka taam uh hi.
Sabbath ni-in khua kongpi pualam ah pusuakin thungetna phual om dinga ka upmawh uh gun gei-ah ka pai uh a, tusukin a na kikhawm numeite' kiangah thu ka gen uh hi.
Thungaite lakah Thyatira khuami, puanthan sandum nam a zuak, Pasian a bia, Lydia minnei numei khat zong om hi. Paul' thugen a kinbawl nadingin Topa in tua numeinu' lungsim honsak hi.
Tua numeinu in amah leh a innkuanpihte a kibaptize khit uh ciangin, “Topa' thu-um ci-in nong ngaihsut takpi uhleh ka inn ah hong pai unla hong taam un,” ci-in hong thum a, nakpi-in kote hong kho hi.
Thungetna phual ka zuat laitakun gulpi ai a nei, mailam thu genkholhna tawh a tote' tungah a met a pung tampi a tun, dawi tawh kikop sawltangzang numei khat in hong dawntuah hi.
Tua numeinu in Paul leh ko teng hong zui-in, “Hih mite pen note' kianga hotkhiatna lampi hong pulak, Sangpen Pasian' silate ahi uh hi,” ci-in kiko hi.

Tu-a danin ni tampi sung hih den hi. Paul in nopmawh a sak luat ciangin kihei-in kha' kiangah, “Hih numeinu' sungpan na pusuah nading Jesu Khris min tawh thupiak kong bawl hi,” ci hi. Tua hunlenai lianin tua kha zong pusuak pah hi.
Ahih hangin numeinu' tote in a met a pung a lametna uh bei cih a phawk uh ciangin Paul leh Silas man uh a, uliante' kiang sumbuktual ah kai uh hi.
Thukhen uliante' kiangah a tunpih uh ciangin amaute in, “Hih mite Jew mi hinapi-un i khua hong toknawi uh hi.
Rome mi ka hihna uh tawh kote' san ding leh zuih ding phaltheih ahilo ngeina zatziate hong pulak uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Mihonpi in sawltakte a kisukna pawlpih uh a, thukhen uliante in zong sawltakte a puan uh a suahkhiatsak khit uh ciangin sat nading thupia uh hi.
Satliamna tampi a piansak khit uh ciangin thong sungah khum uh a, bittak a cin nadingin thong-ukpa' kiangah thupia uh hi.
Tua dan thupiakna a ngah ciangin thong-ukpa in zong thong-inn a tawngnunglam ah amaute koihin a khete uh kol bulh hi.
Zankim laitak Paul leh Silas in Pasian' kiangah thungenin biakpiak late sa uh a, thongkiate in tua a ngaih laitak
thakhat thu-in zinling khauh mahmah khat tung ahih manin thonginn khuambul teng kilok hi. Tua lianleh kongkhak khempeuh kihong a, mi khempeuh a kikhihna teng uh kiphel hi.
Thong-ukpa khanglo a, thong kongkhak teng kihong a muh ciangin thongkiate a taimang khinta sa ahih manin a namsau dokin amahmah kithah sawm hi.
Ahih hangin Paul awging lianpi tawh kiko a, “Nanglenang bangmah kicih kei in. Hih takah ka vekun ka om uh hi,” ci hi.
Thong-ukpa zong meivak ngenin thonginn sung kikhawh a, launa leh linna tawh Paul leh Silas mai-ah boksuk hi.
Tua ciangin amaute pusuahpih a, “Tote aw, hotkhiatna ngah nadingin bang ka hih ding hiam?” ci hi.
Amaute in, “Topa Jesu um in. Tua hileh nang leh na innkuanpihte in hotkhiatna na ngah ding uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin thong-ukpa leh ama' inn sung mi khempeuh' tungah Topa' thu gen uh hi.
Zankim tua hunlenai lian mahin thong-ukpa in amaute gel samin a liammate uh silsak a, ama' innkuanpih teng tawh a vekun kibaptize pah uh hi.
Tua ciangin a inn ah amaute ciahpihin a mai-uhah ankuang luui a, Pasian a up khak manin a innkuanpih teng tawh gualnuamkhawm uh hi.
Khuavak ciangin thukhen uliante in palikte sawl uh a, “Tua mite va khah un,” ci uh hi.
Thong-ukpa in tua thute Paul ko a, “Thukhen uliante in note hong khahsak uh hi. Tua ahih manin hong pusuak unla lungnuamtak na pai ta un,” ci hi.

Ahih hangin Paul in amaute' kiangah, “Rome gammi ahi kote, mawhmat thudot om lo pi-in amaute in a langtangin hong satin thong sung hong khum uh hi. Tu-in a simthamin hong khah uh ahi hiam? Hitheilo hi. Amaumah hong pai uh henla hong pusuahpih uh hen,” ci hi.
Palikte in hih thute thukhen uliante' kiangah ko uh a, amaute zong Paul leh Silas Rome gammi ahihna a theih uh ciangin lau mahmah uh hi.
Tua hangin amaute hong pai uh a, Paul leh Silas pusuahpihin khua pan a paikhiat nadingun thum uh hi.
Paul leh Silas zong thong sungpan pusuakin Lydia' kiangah baang uh hi. Sanggamte a muh uh ciangin amaute hanthawn uh a, tua ciangin paikhia uh hi.
